faq_heading: Neilsen Grove houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Neilsen Grove sell for?
faq.a: 16 houses sold in Neilsen Grove between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,362,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Neilsen Grove?
faq.a: The median was 30 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.5% of the last list price (6% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Neilsen Grove sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 16 houses that sold in Neilsen Grove went for between $1,249,925 and $1,671,000, around a median of $1,362,500.

faq.q: Do houses in Neilsen Grove sell above asking price?
faq.a: 6% of the 16 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 95.5% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Neilsen Grove?
faq.a: The median year built was 1994 for the 16 houses sold in Neilsen Grove.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Neilsen Grove usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Neilsen Grove had 4 bedrooms, from the 16 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Neilsen Grove houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

16 houses sold in Neilsen Grove with a median price of $1,362,500 (the middle half sold between $1,249,925 and $1,671,000), taking a median of 30 days to sell at 95.5% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $683 per square foot, a median year built of 1994 and a median lot of 5,129 square feet.
How Neilsen Grove compares with the rest of Ladner

The median house in Neilsen Grove sold for $1,362,500, about the same as the Ladner median of $1,340,000 across 117 sales. Neilsen Grove houses took a median 30 days to sell, against 16 days for Ladner as a whole.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a community is listed only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.
